collection.title: Theme
collection.description: Colors for the whole app. Each theme has a light and a dark variant that follow the mode below.
collection.label: Theme collection

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Light, dark, or follow your system setting.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the interface, dates and numbers.

density.title: Density
density.description: Height of the rows in the message list.

readingPane.title: Reading pane
readingPane.description: Where the open message is shown.

accentHint: The accent color is set for each mailbox in the “Mailboxes” tab and takes precedence over the theme’s accent.

undoSend.title: Undo send delay
undoSend.label: Undo send delay in seconds
undoSend.description_one: You have {{count}} second to undo after clicking Send.
undoSend.description_other: You have {{count}} seconds to undo after clicking Send.

remoteImages.title: Remote images
remoteImages.description: Externally hosted images can be used to track you. You can still show them case by case.

trusted.title: Trusted senders
trusted.description_one: {{count}} sender whose images are always shown.
trusted.description_other: {{count}} senders whose images are always shown.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notification when a message arrives in the Inbox, even when the app is closed, and the number of unread conversations on the app icon.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked by the browser

mailto.title: Default email app
mailto.description: Open “mailto:” links from other sites in Voxel. Your browser asks for confirmation.
mailto.done: Confirm in your browser to finish.
mailto.unsupported: Your browser doesn’t let websites handle email links.

receipts.title: Read receipts
receipts.description: When a sender asks for a read receipt.

background.title: Keep running in the background
background.description: Closing the window leaves Voxel in the notification area: new mail is still notified and counted on its icon. To quit, use “Quit Voxel” on that icon.

autostart.title: Start with your computer
autostart.description: Voxel starts in the background when you sign in, so no message is missed.
autostart.failed: Could not change the startup setting

largeFiles.title: Large attachments
largeFiles.description: Attachments over {{threshold}} are sent as a link, valid for {{days}} days, from {{quota}} of S3 space per mailbox. The S3 account is created automatically the first time.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Voxel {{version}}. New versions are looked for at startup and every 6 hours, and are installed only when you choose to.

shortcuts.hint: Press “?” anywhere to show this help.
